about.title: Pacifica Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Pacifica residents rely on everyday products at home, on the job, and while getting around a coastal town shaped by Highway 1 and Sharp Park Road. When a product fails because of a manufacturing flaw, a poor design, or a missing warning, the harm can be serious and the path to answers confusing. California generally allows injured people to pursue strict liability claims, meaning you may not have to prove the manufacturer was careless — only that the product was defective and caused your injury. That can include vehicle parts, tools, appliances, recreational gear, or safety equipment. LawProactive is not a law firm; we're a free service that connects Pacifica residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened, help identify who along the supply chain may share responsibility, and explain next steps. If a product hurt you or someone you love here, preserving the item and any packaging matters. Reaching out costs nothing, and there's no obligation to move forward.

whyChoose.title: Why Pacifica Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Case
items.desc: California's strict liability rules often mean you don't need to prove the manufacturer was negligent — just that a defect existed and caused harm. An independent attorney can help determine whether your case fits this standard.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable for a defective product. A connected attorney can help sort out who was involved in getting the product into your hands.

items.title: Free Connection, No Upfront Cost
items.desc: LawProactive doesn't charge you anything to connect with an attorney, and attorneys in our network typically work on contingency — no fee unless you recover compensation.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, including any packaging, instructions, or remaining pieces. Don't attempt repairs or throw anything away, since the product itself is often the most important evidence in these claims. An attorney can advise on proper storage and documentation.

items.question: Does a defective product injury in Pacifica get handled differently than elsewhere in California?
items.answer: The core legal standards are set by California law and apply statewide, but local factors can matter — for example, whether the incident happened near a Pacifica business, a job site, or while using the product along routes like Highway 1 or Sharp Park Road. An independent attorney familiar with San Mateo County can help sort through those details.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer knew about the defect?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California's strict liability approach generally focuses on whether the product itself was defective and caused injury, rather than what the manufacturer knew or intended. This can make it somewhat easier to pursue a claim compared to a standard negligence case.
